verdict.rationale: Omnara is an agent-hosting platform, so autonomous environment setup is a fair question for it. However, the evidence never documents agents cloning repositories, installing dependencies, or configuring their own working environment. Running on connected machines, skills, and MCP tools are building blocks a developer could use, not this capability itself.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have an agent automatically clone the repo, install dependencies, and configure its own working environment
